modules.title: title 与页面正文怎样分工

items.title: 它首先服务浏览器标签
items.text: title 写在文档头部，浏览器使用它标识当前文档。详情页应包含能区分对象的名称，而不是所有页面都写同一个通用标题。

items.title: 搜索结果不是固定回显
items.text: 搜索系统可能参考 title、正文或其他信号生成结果标题，因此应验收浏览器标签与页面源码；不要把搜索结果原样显示当作必然结果。

modules.title: 它不等于 H1 或搜索标题
modules.text: {c:title-tag} 是文档头部的页面标题；{c:html} 里的 H1 是正文层级标题；搜索系统展示的标题可能参考二者但可以重写。修改 H1 不会自动修改 title。

lessonPractice.title: 两个商品详情页共用“商品详情”这个标签标题，用户切换页面时分不清。浏览器标签页标题应该怎么写？

options.label: 让每个页面的 title 包含对应商品名，并保留页面里的 H1
options.feedback: 对。title 负责浏览器文档标识，商品名能帮助区分页面；H1 仍负责页面正文层级。

options.label: 只把页面 H1 改成商品名，不修改 head 里的 title
options.feedback: H1 的变化不会自动证明浏览器标签页的 title 已经按页面更新。

options.label: 只调整 title 的关键词，保证搜索结果一定原样显示
options.feedback: 搜索系统可能参考 title，但不保证原样采用；当前页面首先要解决标签页识别问题。

en.title: Two product pages share the tab title Product details, so people cannot tell them apart. How should it change?

options.label: Include the matching product name in each page's title and keep the page H1
options.feedback: Correct. The title identifies the document in the browser, while the product name distinguishes pages and the H1 keeps its content hierarchy.

options.label: Change only the page H1 and leave the title in the head unchanged
options.feedback: Changing the H1 does not prove that the browser tab title updates per page.

options.label: Only tune title keywords and promise that search will always copy them exactly
options.feedback: Search systems may use the title but are not required to copy it exactly; first solve page identification in the tab.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请让每个商品详情页生成包含商品名的独立 title，保留页面 H1 不变。切换两个商品后检查浏览器标签标题确实变化；不要承诺搜索结果会原样显示 title。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Give each product detail page a distinct title that includes the product name, while keeping the page H1. Switch between two products and verify that the browser tab changes; do not promise that search results will copy the title exactly.

references.title: Google 搜索结果标题链接

learning.assumes: You have seen a browser tab title and a large heading inside a page.
learning.outcome: You can tell whether a title identifies the current page and distinguish the title element, H1, and a search result title that may be rewritten.

modules.title: How the title and page content divide the job

items.title: It first serves the browser tab
items.text: The title lives in the document head and identifies the current document in the browser. A detail page should include a name that distinguishes the object rather than reuse one generic title everywhere.

items.title: Search results are not a fixed echo
items.text: A search system may use the title, page text, or other signals to generate a result title. Verify the browser tab and source metadata; do not treat exact search echoing as guaranteed.

modules.title: It is not the H1 or search title
modules.text: {c:title-tag} is the document title in the head; an H1 in {c:html} is a content heading; a search system may use either but can rewrite its result title. Changing the H1 does not automatically change the title element.

distinctions.label: Page metadata
distinctions.text: {c:title-tag} is one concrete page-metadata field that mainly identifies the document; {c:page-metadata} also covers other head information read by different platforms.

distinctions.label: HTML
distinctions.text: {c:title-tag} is a title field inside an HTML document; {c:html} is the whole markup language used to describe web structure.
